basis: Astec’s May 1 earnings release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. Its consolidated GAAP income statement reports net sales of $309.2 million for the three months ended March 31, 2024, versus $347.9 million a year earlier. That was an 11.1% decline and $21.305 million below the $330.505 million threshold. Astec reassigned operations between reporting segments, but the consolidated prior-year total remained $347.9 million.

coverage.detail: November 1, 2023, preceding earnings cycle. The Q3 release discussed sales, backlog and delayed shipments. It gave no numeric Q1 2024 consolidated sales forecast.

The issuer-hosted November 1 Q3 call transcript identifies the roughly $235 million to $240 million figures in Q&A as implied orders in the preceding three quarters. Management gave no Q1 2024 consolidated sales ceiling.
February 28, 2024, immediately preceding release. The $337.2 million of net sales and 3.6% decline were Q4 2023 actuals. The release gave no Q1 2024 sales range.

On the February 28 presentation and call, the CEO discussed flat to single-digit growth for full-year 2024. His Q1 remarks addressed bookings, international shipments and parts demand. None quantified a consolidated Q1 net-sales ceiling.
March 7 interim 8-K exhibit announced the appointment of an interim CFO. It contained no preliminary sales figure or updated quarterly guidance.
Astec’s April 29 announcement concerned the quarterly dividend and gave no Q1 sales update.

The April 30 8-K reported voting results from the April 25 annual meeting. The search of intervening filings, issuer announcements, investor presentations and public management remarks located no earlier qualifying sales forecast or preliminary result.
May 1 issuer release confirms the March 31 quarter, the consolidated comparison and the segment reassignments. The GAAP table presents sales to the nearest $0.1 million.
Astec’s original wire release identifies Astec Industries as the source and records distribution at 7:00 a.m. Eastern on May 1, before the 8:30 a.m. earnings call.

publication_date_evidence: Astec’s investor-relations release and SEC Exhibit 99.1 both carry the May 1, 2024 dateline. The issuer’s wire timestamp confirms the results became public that morning, one day before the May 2 Form 10-Q filing.
